rev.t: " Cheta oru Chaya " ☕ One of my favorite tea spots in HSR.. Delicious shawarma is now available here after 3 PM. Definitely worth trying!  🤤🫶🏻 …

Tried the Lemon Honey Tea, and it was really good. It cost just ₹25. The tea was refreshing, with a nice balance of lemon and honey, making it a perfect drink for a quick break.
I would recommend you to give a try.

Good spot for a night honey lemon tea. Always crowded and the tea is good. It used to be too good with enough honey and all, but recently the amount of honey got reduced. But overall it's a nice place for affordable tasty lemon tea.
